summary: Documents the Not-So-Stubby Area option for OSPF. An NSSA is like an OSPF stub area but can still import some external routes in a limited way. It builds on the earlier definition in RFC 1587, with changes that expand capability while staying backward-compatible, so implementations of both interoperate.

eli5.summary: Some neighborhoods in a road network are normally closed to outside roads. This lets a few special outside roads connect in anyway, in a small controlled way.

questions: how do nssa areas import external routes
